title: Small Lie algebras in the Verlinde category
summary: This paper studies simple Lie algebras in the Verlinde category, with canonical fundamental group action, using combinatorial methods. We give an exhaustive list of such Lie algebras which either have length at most 3, or appear as a subalgebra of the restriction of the Lie algebra of a simple algebraic group along a principal morphism. The results and exceptions answer several questions and conjectures regarding Verlinde categories of algebraic groups and their Lie algebras.
